heaviest_rainfall.status: 22.76mm of rain was recorded as having fallen today, marking an exceptional precipitation event and it ranked 9th out of our records.  A rate of 9.4mm per hour was recorded during the 33.3 hour long storm.  The heaviest total rainfall occurred on 09 November 2025, dropping 47.89mm of rain over the 144.8 hour storm duration with a maximum rate of 24.6mm per hour.

heaviest_rainrate.status: On 02 September 2025, the rain fell at an exceptional rate, peaking at 34.3mm per hour, the heaviest downpour recorded.  A total of 21.19mm fell over the 15.0 hour storm.

longest_rain.status: A storm today ranked 5th for the longest continuous rainfall according to our records, lasting a total of33.3 hours.  It came with 22.76mm of rainfall, at times, falling at 9.4mm per hour.  The longest rain storm on record lasted 144.8 hours on 09 November 2025 when 47.89mm of rain fell and at one point was falling at 24.6mm per hour.
